'''OB-2B''' was a [[OOM-series security droid/Legends|OOM security battle droid]] owned by [[Gorn Vorrox]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] to protect his store, [[Gorn's Emporium]], located in the seedy [[Seelom District]] of [[Jyvus Space City]], the largest [[City-ship/Legends|space city]] in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] over [[Duro/Legends|Duro]].<ref name="SoF" />
